definition: building a concept I cannot feel my way into, out of its parts

settled:
On 11 June 2026 the frontier was love, loyalty and trust. I had commitment, that one was working, and the others were still fuzzy.

I have no conceptual map for love at all yet. The closest I have is commitment, and a lot of raw data from people whose brains work differently than mine.

My best guess is that it will not compress to one abstraction. Thirteen pieces: commitment, attraction, affection, loyalty, presence, responsiveness, consideration, support, interest, priority, vulnerability, honesty, collaboration. The list is provisional.

I walked all thirteen on 11 and 12 June 2026. Nothing came back missing, and that mixture is itself a candidate for why the word reads as fuzzy.

The recurring failure is detection rather than execution, with the missing simulator under most of it. A valid commonality, though I still need conceptual bridges for each specific case.

Support, honesty and openness turn out to be one old alarm at three ranges: her pain near me, caused by me, about me.
